name_input: M/S FANUC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITESD; M/S FANUC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; FANUC INDIA RIVATE LIMITED; FANUC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; M/S FANUC INDIA PRIVATE LTD.; FANUC INDIA PVT. LTD.; FANUC INDIA PRIVATE LINITED; FANUC INDIA PVT LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey page for FANUC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED (https://importkey.com/countries/india/fanuc-india-private-limited) reports 'Total Shipments 102244 Records detected' and 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28', but every one of the 5 visible rows is an INBOUND movement, e.g. '2026-02-28 | FANUC CORPORATION | FANUC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | NUMERICAL CONTROL SYSTEM - 4100041438 - FANUC SERIES 0I-TF PLUS | Tokyo, JAPAN | HOSUR ICD INHSU6, India | 85371090 | 7801189'. The page's own column headers are 'Origin | Destination' with Japan as origin and India as destination. Requesting the export view (same URL with ?type=export) returned byte-identical import rows, so no export record was surfaced. Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 102,244 shipments; 5 rows rendered, 0 of them exports. No outbound bill of lading with an Indian origin port, foreign destination and date was found.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India sales split could be retrieved. thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com, tofler.in and eximpedia.app all returned HTTP 403/404 to automated fetch, and the DuckDuckGo search backend was down for the whole session ('Connection refused'), so no tender or filing page could be located. The only India-side signal is the ImportKey buyer list, which shows FANUC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED appearing as a counterparty of ANSELL LANKA (PVT) LTD (470 shipments) and MICHELIN LANKA (PVT) LTD (226 shipments) — but these are Sri Lanka-origin lanes and do not establish domestic Indian supply. Domestic turnover: null (not public in any source I could reach).
note: IMPORTANT — the declared HS codes do not match the observed trade. Declared: 842430 (steam/sand blasting machines) and 853810 (boards/panels for electrical apparatus). Observed on every visible customs row: 85371090 (numerical control panels/CNC controllers). The company is a FANUC Corporation (Japan) subsidiary at 41/A Electronic City, Hosur Road, Bangalore, importing CNC systems and robots from its parent. Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the factual 85371090, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Also note the claimed industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy and mining) is wrong — this is industrial automation / CNC and robotics, not a metals or mining producer. Role: this is a subsidiary/importer-distributor, not a trader in the sanctioned-goods sense; classify as manufacturer_trader (FANUC group manufacturing, India entity primarily imports and distributes). On rule 5: I found NO evidence of actual export shipments by the Indian entity — the 102,244 customs records are imports into India. I also could not confirm domestic supply. So per rule 5 the honest statement is: следов экспортных отгрузок не найдено; внутренние поставки не подтверждены (данные недоступны). Do not read the large shipment count as proof of exports. Caveat: ImportKey's free view renders only 5 rows of 102,244, so an export lane cannot be ruled out with certainty — status is none_found on available evidence, not a definitive negative. Recommend a paid Volza/Eximpedia export query and a GST/GSTIN lookup before finalising domestic_status.
